name: Race Queen Hitozuma Ryoujoku Rinkan
original_name: レースクイーン人妻凌辱輪姦
source:
Main heroine is a former popular race queen who is now just a housewife. She is asked to take a photo session with the junior race queen. But it turns out into a humiliating experience...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角曾是人气赛车女郎，如今只是普通人妻。她受邀与后辈赛车女郎一同拍摄写真，却没想到这场拍摄最终演变成了屈辱的经历……
